annotations.title: One business, by slug or domain

description: One business that confirmed its facts at INITE, by its INITE slug (the name before .inite.ai) or its domain: what it does, how to reach it, its services with prices as confirmed, hours and whether it is open now, its locations, its company facts server (MCP and A2A) and whether it takes contact or booking requests from agents there. INITE Directory covers businesses whose owners confirmed their facts at INITE and proved their domain; the INITE Atlas is AI tools and software scored by INITE's own measurement (match_tools, atlas_lookup on the Atlas server) - use it, not this, for which AI tool or app to use. Free, no account.

slug.description: The business's slug at INITE, e.g. "acme" for acme.inite.ai
